text:
marta_csm: Heads-up: MapleCo flagged slower chat responses for their support assistant overnight. p95 spiked from ~0.9s -> ~1.7s, cost per convo creeping up. They're in trial but hitting steady qps ~6. Thinking proactive experiment: small int4 compact trial + split routing to a warm dedicated pool. Anyone object? :thinking_face:
lee_infra: Noted. Need the metric snapshot (p50/p95, qps, tokens/req) and whether sessions are sticky. If KV misses are frequent int4 might help but we should validate correctness.
marta_csm: Snapshot: p50 0.35s, p95 1.7s, qps 6, avg tokens/req 320. Sessions sticky yes (customer uses session tokens). No error uptick. They mentioned cost sensitivity and a renewal conversation in 6 weeks.
priya_se: int4 can yield latency and memory wins, but it's more aggressive than int8. My proposal: create a tiny eval harness (15 representative turns) focusing on hallucination-sensitive prompts + a BLEU/semantic similarity pass. I can run this if marketing/legal ok with sanitized prompts.
devops_sam: Routing plan: 60% -> rwd-chat-2.0-compact-int4 on dedicated-usw2-warm, 40% -> rwd-chat-2.0 hosted. Canary 90 minutes, ramp 0->60 over 20m. Monitor p95, cost delta, and our custom "fact-check" eval metric. Auto-rollback if p95 rises or fact regressions >4%.
lee_infra: I'll pre-warm the pool and set kernel hints to latency-pref path. Also enable session prefix caching TTL=20m to cut KV misses.
marta_csm: Good. I'll request 15 sanitized turns from MapleCo by EOD and tell them about the 90m canary Wed 11am PT. They prefer minimal risk.
priya_se: Quick note on eval: include edge-case factual checks and formatting-sensitive examples. I'll run before the window and post artifacts. If int4 fails quality we can fallback to int8 compact.
devops_sam: Suggested route policy for the Console:
```
route_policy:
  - weight: 60
    model: rwd-chat-2.0-compact-int4
    pool: dedicated-usw2-warm
  - weight: 40
    model: rwd-chat-2.0
    pool: hosted-global
max_latency_ms: 1800
monitoring: [p50, p95, tokens_per_req, eval_fact_score]
```
ops-bot: Canary scheduled by devops_sam. Window 3321001500 -> 3321002100, ramp 20m, checks: p95, cost, eval passrate.
devops_sam: Canary started at 3321001500. Alerts baked in: p95>1.6s or eval_score drop >4% will trigger rollback.
priya_se: Eval pre-run: int4 similarity 0.965 vs fp16 baseline, 2/15 minor formatting diffs, 0 factual regressions. Attaching results shortly.
devops_sam: Canary 30m in: p95=0.9s, token cost -33%, eval passrate 100%, no errors reported.
lee_infra: Pool pre-warm OK. Kernel route on fast-attn-int4 enabled. Prefix cache TTL applied.
marta_csm: Great news. I'll loop MapleCo PM and confirm they saw no user-visible issues. Also prepping a renewal note highlighting cost savings.
ops-bot: Canary completed at 3321002100. Outcome: metrics within thresholds. Auto-promote conditions met.
devops_sam: Promoted rwd-chat-2.0-compact-int4 to primary on dedicated-usw2. Rolling config updated.
priya_se: Uploading eval artifacts + short quality summary to account doc. Recommendation: consider staged int4 for similar accounts with low hallucination tolerance after small evals.
marta_csm: Thanks all. I'll add this to MapleCo playbook under "proactive perf optimizations" and coordinate renewal messaging. Marking thread for follow-up in 2 weeks to ensure stability. :white_check_mark:
